header.name: Grand Ocean Aquarium V04
header.description: Grand Ocean Aquarium, increment 4 of 6 (about 500 objects). A 100 x 60 x 28 ft tank, two storeys tall, with a 100 ft walk-through tunnel, and from V06 small rooms on two levels. Tap an animal to read about it. Sizes are estimates, in inches.
